text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki,
mesmerized the crowd with a fantastic run――!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —*gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You're completely exhausted!
So your aptitude really was more geared toward miles...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
D-Do your best, Fuji Kiseki!
I'll be cheering for you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: That was a great race! I was so moved!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Amidst the commotion, Fuji Kiseki slowly rose to her feet—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, phew...
Hehe, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She raised a firm fist in determination!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! I'm so worried and excited all at once~!
E-E-Even falling to her knees, she looks so gorgeous~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fuji is an entertainer of unmatched caliber, after all.
Even that might be part of the show...! Wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
............
Maybe I'll watch for just a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! It looked like everyone in the stands
was having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Above all, she came to watch.
Her expression didn't look bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... as expected of the Nippon Derby!
It's a race where only the fiercest competitors gather, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That was truly an amazing race—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all that, ah, what a relief...!
I was able to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her candid, genuine sense of wonder was a rare and heartwarming sight. However, precisely because of this moment, there was something I needed to confirm.
choice_data_list: Do you think you can run the Kikuka Sho?
Do you feel up to running the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her aptitudes, taking on this distance is practically reckless.
It's only natural to feel anxious about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I stared at Fuji Kiseki.
Then—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...It's just, a little...
My heart won't stop trembling—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ugh……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Fuji Kiseki cover her face in tears,
I rush over in a panic.
As I rub her back to comfort her—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When Fuji Kiseki raised her head, she was wearing an elegant Venetian mask reminiscent of a masquerade ball.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I couldn't help myself.
Sorry, did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, if she has the energy to pull pranks,
she'll surely be just fine.
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and do our best in the Kikuka Sho too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The Nippon Derby pushed us to our absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho's 3,000 meters is a long-distance race
built specifically for stayers—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone will surely be thinking:
'There's no way it'll even be a contest next time!'"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... I will definitely overcome this wall,
brilliantly and dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's get stronger this summer, Trainer!
The target race has been set to the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Kikuka Sho where formidable rivals await,
the days of racing through summer have begun!
